fusions.name: Stooping Kick
fusions.desc: Glides you up to 8 tiles onto a target and lands a kick for 12 damage, rising to 1.8 times that from full range.

fusions.name: Moulting Scatter
fusions.desc: Looses 3 quills at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Gliding Bound
fusions.desc: Carries you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Hollow Bones
fusions.desc: Raises your Speed by 1, and your Speed ceiling by 1. From bronze rank you move 5% faster, from silver your dodge chance rises by 5%, and from gold you attack 8% faster.
